company_name: Yantai AWSOM Brake Material Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Yantai AWSOM Brake Material Co., Ltd. specializes in carbon fiber products that are directly applicable to semiconductor substrate growth and thermal insulation.
summary: Yantai AWSOM Brake Material Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced carbon fiber materials, including thermal insulation and composite materials, specifically designed for the semiconductor industry. Their products are utilized in substrate growth processes, particularly for third-generation semiconductors, demonstrating significant energy efficiency and performance.
capabilities: Viscose-based short-fiber solidified felt for substrate growth
Carbon-carbon composite materials for high-temperature applications
Customized carbon fiber products for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and exports products to various countries and regions.
